title: Only PostHog Desktop OAuth grants may select claude_model_access=own-subscription
answers: Why does my API key get 400 on claude_model_access own-subscription?
Cloud run on own Claude plan times out after 120 seconds
Who can start a task run with their Claude plan?
body:
Selecting `claude_model_access="own-subscription"` on run creation requires a consented OAuth token from the Desktop app's OAuth application. Personal API keys, browser sessions, sandbox tokens and other OAuth clients get a 400 on `claude_model_access`.
- Enforced in `products/tasks/backend/presentation/serializers.py:_validate_subscription_caller`, using `_is_desktop_app_grant`. That helper combines `get_oauth_client_id(request) in POSTHOG_CODE_OAUTH_APP_CLIENT_IDS` with `is_interactive_desktop_grant(request)`.
- It is an allow-list, not a deny-list of sandbox tokens. The mobile client (`POSTHOG_DESKTOP_MOBILE_APP_CLIENT_ID_US`) counts as Desktop for task provenance but is deliberately excluded, because it cannot hand over a Claude token.
- If the check is skipped, the sandbox asks a Desktop that isn't watching the run for a Claude token, and the run fails after the 120s timeout.
- The check is shared by TaskRunCreateRequestSerializer and TaskRunBootstrapCreateRequestSerializer, so both `/run/` and `/runs/` are covered.
applies: products/tasks run-creation serializers (/run/ and /runs/); any new caller or client that sets claude_model_access
